applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
Use the receiving bank's instructions and the Portal fields for the actual country and currency.

| Arrangement | Requirement |
|---|---|
| US local route | Nine-digit ABA routing number. |
| UK local route | Six-digit sort code. |
| Australian route | Supply the BSB and account number in their requested fields; the combined form uses the six-digit BSB and the supported account field. |
| New Zealand local account | Ten-digit account field: seven-digit account plus three-digit suffix. Prefix a two-digit suffix with zero. |
| Kazakhstan, any supported currency | Both IBAN and SWIFT code. |
| CNY company account | Bank-branch clearing code required. |
| CNY personal account | Branch clearing code optional. |
| Canadian or Australian bank | Recipient address required. |

For a New Zealand account, `1234567-02` becomes `1234567002` in the ten-digit field. Do not add a different country's routing code to that field.

An offshore account opened in mainland China still uses China as the bank location. Confirm the bank country from the actual bank details; the fifth and sixth BIC characters identify the country in that code.

For a Hong Kong CNH recipient, use the individual's residence address or the company's registered/business address. For an Indonesian IDR company recipient, record residency according to the company's registration country. Third-party company recipients use their own registered or business address.

title: Recipient bank fields by country and currency
